qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Commodity off-patent generics and biosimilars manufacturer facing continuous annual low-to-mid single digit price deflation, tender bidding, and government reference price cuts. Sandoz possesses zero pricing power >= inflation across its core volume base.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (N, REJECT). Pure-play generic and biosimilar drug manufacturer subject to structural price deflation and competitive tender bidding. Lacks pricing power >= inflation across its commodity pharmaceuticals portfolio.
qualitative.evidence: Spun off from Novartis in late 2023. Core generics portfolio suffers persistent low-to-mid single-digit annual price erosion from competitive tenders and payer price cuts. While biosimilar volume grows, structural commodity price dynamics in off-patent drugs preclude real pricing power.
